ctx.x: Who was with you at Panama as a musical accompaniment? Do you remember the orchestra or your pianist?

Now, uh, the pianist was, uh, Jerry Wilson. He used to make all my orchestrate, arrange all my orchestrations for me. Jerry Wilson was a pianist, like, you know, pianist. And I don't know who all was in his orchestra. I can't think.
